description: Visitor stats for a name that has a forward or proxy (plain DNS records are not seen). Pro accounts get daily requests and page views plus top countries; free accounts get the period total and an 'upgrade' offer. 'days' is 1 to 90 (default 30).

days.description: How many days back to count (default 30).

domain.description: Which domain to act under: 'makes.fyi' (the default) or 'agentdomains.co'. The same label can exist under each, so pass this whenever you are not using the default.

label.description: The subdomain label, without the domain suffix (e.g. 'myapp' for myapp.makes.fyi).

name: get_visits
title: Show visitor stats
